---
title: "Stacked Stage"
---

# Vertical navigation is a stack {#stacks-one}

A level-one heading opens a stack; the level-two slides beneath it become its
vertical children. The overview grid is the only place the stage has to lay
those out in two directions at once, so this deck exists to be measured there.

## Inside the first stack {#stack-one-top}

The top of the stack. Overview puts this card in the first row of its column.

## Still in the first stack {#stack-one-middle}

The second card of the column, one vertical pitch below the one above it.

## The end of the first stack {#stack-one-bottom}

The third and last card of the column.

# A second stack {#stacks-two}

Two stacks side by side give the grid both a row and a column to measure.

## Inside the second stack {#stack-two-top}

The top of the second column.

## Still in the second stack {#stack-two-middle}

The second card of the second column.
